components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Shared primary action for a deliberate operational command.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5b9cf3, #2f6fe0); color: #fff; font: 500 14px Montserrat, sans-serif; transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(76,147,255,.25); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b9cf3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Live Badge
components.description: Compact freshness marker for data connected in real time.
components.css: .ds-live-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid #3474b5; border-radius: 6px; background: #143861; color: #eff6ff; font: 800 11px Montserrat, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-live-badge i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4de0a1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(77,224,161,.12); }

components.name: Attention Ribbon
components.description: Top-level active exception with direct path to the responsible operation.

components.css: .ds-attention { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 17px; min-height: 74px; padding: 14px 18px; border: 1px solid #c98b1b; border-radius: 12px; background: #3d2a0b; color: #f0f5fb; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; } .ds-attention-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255,198,64,.12); color: #ffc853; font-weight: 800; } .ds-attention strong, .ds-attention small { display: block; } .ds-attention strong { font-size: 14px; } .ds-attention small { margin-top: 4px; color: #b6c4d4; font-size: 12px; } .ds-attention a { color: #f8fbff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none; } .ds-attention a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b9cf3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: Actionable domain row combining metric, trend, and next destination.

components.css: .ds-lane { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 46px minmax(120px,1fr) minmax(112px,.75fr) minmax(170px,.8fr); align-items: center; min-height: 92px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #203c56; border-radius: 12px; background: #0b1d2f; color: #edf5fd; text-decoration: none; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; transition: transform .22s ease, border-color .22s ease, background .22s ease; } .ds-lane:hover { transform: translateX(4px); border-color: #4d88be; background: #0e263d; } .ds-lane:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b9cf3; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-lane-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; margin-left: 15px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(91,156,243,.13); color: #5b9cf3; font-weight: 800; } .ds-lane strong, .ds-lane small { display: block; } .ds-lane strong { font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-lane small { margin-top: 4px; color: #9eb1c5; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-metric { color: #fff; font: 800 28px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: -.06em; } .ds-next { padding: 0 16px; color: #aebdcd; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Activity Rail Item
components.description: Compact timestamped event in the quieter activity rail.
components.css: .ds-activity { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 9px; align-items: start; padding: 13px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(63,91,117,.5); color: #dce7f2; background: #091827; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background .18s ease; } .ds-activity:hover { background: #102842; } .ds-activity:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b9cf3; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-activity i { width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-top: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: #56a4ff; } .ds-activity strong, .ds-activity small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-activity strong { font-size: 12px; } .ds-activity small { margin-top: 3px; color: #8299b0; font-size: 10px; } .ds-activity time { color: #75a9e3; font: 10px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; }

components.name: Operational Badge
components.description: Shared compact category or state label; its dot reinforces but does not replace text.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(239,179,50,.2); border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(239,179,50,.12); color: #ffdc7a; font: 600 11.5px Montserrat, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; } .ds-badge i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #efb332; }

narrative.overview: ARCIL is a dense, dark operational console whose visual hierarchy works at close range and on an owner’s TV. The baseline is ink-blue and porcelain rather than neutral dashboard gray: it reads as an active control desk, with precise data and clear destinations instead of a generic card grid. The system treats every domain as a live line in a broadcast rundown. A domain’s state, trend, and next destination are visible in one horizontal scan; a single attention ribbon owns the exception state. This keeps normal information calm while making a real issue unmistakable.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-blue tonal layering, separated by restrained blue structural borders.
Montserrat carries labels and decisions; IBM Plex Mono carries quantities, timestamps, and live data.
Color identifies a domain or an active state; it never carries the meaning alone.
Compact, flat panels and horizontal lanes favor scanning over decoration.

rules.name: The Reserved Attention Rule
rules.body: Amber and red communicate an active state that needs recognition; do not use them for decoration, arbitrary categories, or a routine primary action.

dos: Do lead every operational surface with the state that changes a person’s next action.
Do pair a color signal with copy, an icon, a metric, or another non-color cue.
Do use the mono face for values that users compare across rows or over time.
Do preserve visible focus treatment and the reduced-motion behavior defined globally.
Do favor dense rows, dividers, and meaningful labels over decorative charts or illustrations.
donts: Don't replace the dark rundown system with a pastel dashboard or a generic grid of floating cards.
Don't make amber, red, or glow a normal decorative accent.
Don't hide the only metric or only exception indicator behind hover, tooltip, or interaction.
Don't use large soft shadows, oversized pills, or gradients as a substitute for operational hierarchy.
Don't invent severity for activity events when the data contract only provides event type and time.
